task: J0365: timed Shorts plate boards v01 from locked vo_v02 takes. 100% reuse of the long's KEEP plate boards (0 extra Flow credits). Mint nothing.

shorts.promoted_long_title: What Killed the Dinosaurs Was Hidden in a Line of Clay
shorts.frame0_change_by_1s: Camera already pushing in on the thin dark clay band in the Gubbio cliff with fingertip resting on it at frame 0; hand shifts to reveal the boundary by 1.0 s.

teach_overlay.band: 16:9 centre band (clear of 0–2 s hook and 9–14 s title)

rows.spoken: This thin line of clay marks the end of the dinosaurs.
rows.crop_9x16: 9:16 centre crop on fingertip resting on the thin dark clay band in the Gubbio limestone cliff; hook caption THE LINE at 0.0–2.0 s.

rows.spoken: It's in a cliff in Italy, about a centimetre thick.
rows.crop_9x16: 9:16 crop on Walter Alvarez at the sunlit Gubbio gorge outcrop.

rows.spoken: Below it, the rock is full of tiny fossil shells. Above it, almost all of them are gone.
rows.crop_9x16: 9:16 crop on hand lens over crowded tiny shells below (6.62–10.56 s) then bare rock above (10.56–13.70 s); promoted long title on screen 9.0–14.0 s.

rows.spoken: In nineteen eighty, scientists found the clay was packed with a rare metal from space.
rows.crop_9x16: 9:16 crop on KEEP £0 code graphic P4:01_iridium_spike; DATA label 'THE IRIDIUM SPIKE' at 14.2–18.0 s.

rows.spoken: Something huge had hit the Earth.
rows.crop_9x16: Returns to opening Gubbio clay-line plate so the final frame loops seamlessly into frame 0.

shorts.promoted_long_title: What Killed the Dinosaurs Was Hidden in a Line of Clay
shorts.frame0_change_by_1s: Robin already hopping along a garden fence after a strutting pigeon at frame 0; robin turns its head to camera by 1.0 s.

teach_overlay.band: 16:9 centre band (clear of 0–2 s hook and 9–14 s title)

rows.crop_9x16: 9:16 crop on morning garden robin hopping along the fence; hook caption STILL HERE at 0.0–1.85 s.

rows.spoken: When the asteroid struck, sixty-six million years ago, a few small, feathered ones survived.
rows.crop_9x16: 9:16 crop on dimly lit Cretaceous forest under dust veil (1.85–4.90 s) then KEEP £0 small-bird/seed/ground-nest survivor graphic P5:11_why_survive (4.90–7.92 s); WHEN stamp '66 MILLION YEARS AGO' at 2.2–5.8 s. (Resolves SHORTS_SCRIPTS_v02 'small feathered dinosaur' beat at £0 / 0 Flow credits.)

rows.spoken: Their descendants are all around you now. The pigeon on the pavement. The robin in the garden. The gull at the seaside.
rows.crop_9x16: 9:16 crop on the pigeon and robin in P5:09_robin (7.92–11.82 s) then bird on branch in P5:13_window_song (11.82–15.78 s); promoted long title card on screen 9.0–14.0 s. (Uses the long's two bird plates at 0 extra Flow credits.)

rows.source_long_plate: P1:04_long_reign (2.78 s) + P5:09_robin (4.00 s loop window)
rows.spoken: Every bird you have ever seen is a living dinosaur. Look up. They never really left.
rows.crop_9x16: Cretaceous horizon callback (15.78–18.56 s), then final 4.00 s (18.56–22.56 s) returns to P5:09_robin so the Short loops seamlessly into frame 0.
